quests.title: The Ritou Road

dialogue.t: Well, so this stuff's finally arrived...
Took them long enough...
Agh, and this box is broken on one side, too!
Come on! I told him to be careful. Let's just hope nothing inside is broken...
Phew, looks like none of the bottles broke...
Eh? Why's this bottle's cap loose? You have to unscrew it first before installing it, come on...
*cough* And these alcohol-making ingredients have too strong a flavor, let's move them out first...
Eh!? What are all these slimes doing here?
Thank you, Traveler, thank you so much for your help...
If not for you, this place would have been my grave today...

dialogue.sit: What are you up to here?

dialogue.t: Um, you could say so.
I mean, you know that doing business is hard here on Ritou. This camp is... well, you can consider it a little trick of mine.
Some days back, I commissioned a... friend to ship me some alcohol-making ingredients from Mondstadt.
He then got a test batch of new product from the Dawn Winery, which was just shipped here.
But he hasn't been all that careful, so some of the boxes are broken, and the cap on a bottle of alcohol-making ingredients was loosened.
I decided to unscrew it so that I could then reinstall it.
But I never expected that a whole bunch of slimes would come jumping out of the unscrewed cap. What a strange occurrence.

dialogue.sit: Brewing ingredients from the Dawn Winery, huh...

dialogue.t: Ah, it doesn't matter right now. As for the ingredients, I'll settle with that fellow the next time he comes by.
You've saved my life, and I owe you something for it. Take these first, then.
That aside, you see that small boat over there? That's another one of my little tricks.
Using that boat, you can sneak over to Narukami Island from here. Convenient, huh?

dialogue.sit: And why would I need to "sneak"...

dialogue.t: Ah, you see, this is what they call "expecting the unexpected."
Well, I need to go back and take stock of those goods, so I can't stay here long. Once again, thank you so much, Traveler.
Looks like I'll have to change up my pick-up spot.

quests.description: You happen upon a hidden passageway in Ritou…
